text: async function previewSouVisible(id,y,limitMs=25000){ var before=(await fs.stat(souLogPath)).size; var started=Date.now(); await sky.scroll({window:case08Window,x:1018,y,scrollY:0,scrollX:0}); var match=null,chunk=''; while(Date.now()-started<limitMs){ chunk=(await fs.readFile(souLogPath)).subarray(before).toString('utf8'); if(/Syntax error|error in '/i.test(chunk)) throw new Error('CDB observer error'); var requests=[...chunk.matchAll(/SOU_MENU_REQ seq=(\d+) tick=(\d+) meka=113 weapon=(\d+) variant=(\d+)/g)].filter(m=>Number(m[3])===id); for(var req of requests){ var ready=new RegExp('SOU_MENU_READY seq='+req[1]+' start_seq=(\\d+) tick=(\\d+) meka=113 weapon='+id+' variant='+req[4]+' P=([0-9a-f]+) group=(\\d+) skill=(\\d+)').exec(chunk); if(ready){match={weapon:id,requestSeq:Number(req[1]),variant:Number(req[4]),startSeq:Number(ready[1]),readyTick:Number(ready[2]),actor:ready[3],group:Number(ready[4]),idleSkill:Number(ready[5])};break;} } if(match)break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } var snap=await sky.get_window_state({window:case08Window}); var record={...match,requestedWeapon:id,closed:!!match,elapsedMs:Date.now()-started,logStart:before,logEnd:(await fs.stat(souLogPath)).size}; souUiRecords.push(record); await fs.writeFile(case08Evidence+'/sou-preview-'+String(id).padStart(3,'0')+'-'+Date.now()+'.jpg',Buffer.from(snap.screenshots[0].url.split(',')[1],'base64'),{flag:'wx'}); nodeRepl.write(record); if(!match) throw new Error('No matched native READY for Sou '+id); return record; }
